start_here: Install Python 3.10+, Node.js 18+ and Git. Run python -B tools/dev.py from the repository root. jq 1.7.1 is optional for the jq test.

commands.windows_python_alias: Use py -3 in place of python if needed.
commands.mac_linux_python_alias: Use python3 in place of python if needed.

layout.tools: All build/translation tools, source templates and regression tests.
layout.scripts: Unified UTS/F1 and native Fitness bilingual runtimes; content-addressed release copies are referenced by both subscription aliases.
layout.loon: One unified plugin plus a compatibility alias at the former F1 experimental URL. Install only one.
layout.config/release.json: Version 2: runtime base URL. Build derives full SHA-256 filenames from current sources; assets must be uploaded before plugin imports work.
layout.vendor/pinned: Exact upstream scripts for 114 referenced commit/path pairs, checked by SHA-256 when Git history is absent.
layout.vendor/pinned-manifest.json: Checksums for pinned sources. No separate clone of original Git history required.
layout.vendor/upstream-snapshot.json: Upstream source attribution, snapshot revision and checksums.
layout.payloads: Full upstream payload source snapshot; includes recorded real HLS master structure used in regression tests.
layout.subtitles: Published Chinese M3U8/VTT resources, not embedded in plugin.
layout.examples: Synthetic samples and nonfunctional .test domain config templates.
layout.tests/fixtures: Sanitized clear caption packets and timestamps only. No original media/headers/credentials.
layout.local/catalog.json: Empty custom program catalog; keep private material under ignored local/.
layout.build: Ignored generated base and release artifacts.

requirements.jq: optional; tests were run with jq 1.7.1
requirements.deepseek_key: Set only in Loon plugin arguments; not needed by offline tests.

fitness_flow: Do not intercept play.itunes.apple.com. No Fitness master rewrite, independent Chinese track or single-course injection is used by the unified release.
Select English captions in Fitness+. Native hls-svod.itunes.apple.com Fitness English VTT files are translated in response scripts; each cue shows Chinese then the original English.
Native subtitle playlists, audio and video remain unchanged. Old marker URLs are accepted and old synthetic URLs immediately redirect to native resources.
Translation has a 2-15 second deadline (default 8); return original English on failure. Versioned identity plus original body guards the 128-slot translation cache.
f1_flow_and_limits: One UTS JS dispatcher applies the pinned static catalog first, then registers remaining F1 OnDemand assets by league metadata. No parallel jq UTS rewrite.
Static movies, series, F1 replays and previews retain upstream routing. AI is generic for other F1 OnDemand assets with supported English CC1 CatchUp media.
Rewrite only hlsUrl to the hls-amt master bridge; retain FairPlay certificate, nonce and license URLs. Never intercept linear.tv.apple.com, play.itunes.apple.com or play-edge.itunes.apple.com.
Master GET has a four-second deadline and redirects to original playback on failure. Storage failure also prevents unusable track injection.
Read clear GA94 CEA-608 packets and sample timestamps without decrypting or modifying video. One low-bandwidth caption source per pathway; translation runs only on subtitle requests.
Reuse extracted fragments on duplicate requests. Bounded decoder snapshots are keyed by stream and media boundary time to avoid request-order state contamination across seeks.
Live streams, CEA-708-only content, no-English-CC content and unrecorded CDN formats are not supported by this release.
Actual phone success remains unconfirmed. Tests use reconstructed upstream multivariant structure, sanitized real CC packets and synthetic MP4 fragments.

20261124b coalesces adjacent CEA-608 character-prefix updates within a fragment. Exact normalized source sentences reuse one model-specific Chinese translation across fragments and pathways in 512 bounded slots.

Cached Chinese is retained when a new cue fails. Transient HTTP/network/format errors get at most one retry within deepseek_wait; 401/403 are not retried. Logs record fallback reason and cache counts without caption text or credentials.

Subtitle requests may retrieve one previous fragment with a 1.5 second deadline to reconstruct carried CC. Raw extracted caption frames are cached to repair an eager decode when predecessor state arrives later. Video never waits for translation.
Requests cannot guarantee Chinese when the translation service remains unavailable; only untranslated cues fall back to their own English text. Stability fixes still require phone confirmation.
release_workflow: Edit tools/fitness_deepseek.js, tools/uts_static.js, tools/f1_cc608.js and tools/f1_cc_runtime.js as needed. Pinned catalog is loaded by generate_loon.static_catalog().
Run python -B tools/build_release.py. Review build/ artifacts; copy current loon/ and scripts/ entries returned by build_release.release_files() into the matching repository paths.
Content-addressed runtime filenames include the full SHA-256. Never change the contents of an existing hashed filename. Both plugin URLs reference the same unified implementation.
Run python -B tools/dev.py, which includes build reproducibility, Python and JavaScript checks. --check-published compares local release files only; it does not confirm remote publication.
When publishing is authorized, upload all referenced hashed runtimes before updating plugin subscriptions. Verify remote bytes and URLs, then record real phone feedback in this JSON.

Install only one subscription alias. Disable/remove older enabled copies that still intercept play.itunes.apple.com. If other Loon configuration also decrypts that domain, remove that conflicting entry separately.
upstream_refresh: Get a separate full checkout of rexchen1803/apple-video-subtitles. It is a different repository/history; do not merge it blindly into this main branch.
Review and copy desired updated upstream payloads/client modules. Record the new upstream revision in vendor/upstream-snapshot.json.
Run python -B tools/bundle_upstream.py /path/to/upstream-checkout to refresh fixed-commit dependencies referenced by the current Surge module.
Review data shape changes reported by generator; rerun tests, rebuild and review the stable/experimental plugin diff before publishing.
private_material_not_published: Original ZIP captures, signed playback URLs, request headers/cookies, API keys, local translation model/runtime downloads, and computer paths.
Private raw-capture regression is optional. Sanitized fixtures allow CC decoder work on a fresh clone.

user_preferences: One plugin import; scripts/subtitles may be downloaded remotely. Keep subtitle bodies and API keys out of the plugin.
Keep GitHub free of Markdown; development handoff is JSON.
Fitness+ English-track bilingual display is accepted to remove play.itunes.apple.com interception and resolve Music conflicts.
F1 scope is replay with English CC, with generic detection rather than a race allowlist. No live captions or speech-to-text in this change.
Do not disrupt working playback for diagnostics; clearly distinguish offline checks from real phone confirmation.
